expansion_trigger: Owner direction first adopted a 350-question Production target, then superseded it with the quality-preserving 400-question target. B5 executes the eight already source-audited post-188 Operations gaps while preserving the released 188-question baseline.
evidence: PR #131 merged the durable post-188 gap audit and identified eight defensible Operations propositions.
PR #132 adopted the owner-directed 350-question target while preserving source-first and semantic-collision gates.
PR #143 superseded the 350 target with the quality-preserving 400-question target and permits only controlled variants that satisfy the durable distinctness and review policy.
The current released canonical/runtime baseline remains 188 questions until an explicit later activation gate.
All B5 propositions are outside subsections explicitly marked 〔一等〕 in MLIT 教則第5版.
Independent AI review accepted all eight B5 candidates and Director adjudication adopted all eight decisions.
Eight AI-governed acceptance packets are content-bound and all B5 candidates are READY_FOR_ID.

target_size_decisions.rationale: Owner explicitly directed expansion from the released 188-question baseline to a 350-question Production target while retaining quality gates.
Owner explicitly raised the final Production target to 400 and authorized quality-preserving controlled variants under durable source, distinctness, review and density constraints.

coverage_limit_decisions.scope: Post-188 explicit Operations gaps selected for B5
coverage_limit_decisions.evidence: B5 is limited to the eight source-audited gaps persisted by PR #131. The eight count is an observed defensible set, not a quota, and B5 does not backfill unsupported or one-class-only propositions.

PR #143 changes the policy only for future 400-target expansion by allowing controlled Tier B/C variants under distinctness and density gates. B5 itself remains the eight explicit Tier A source gaps already reviewed and accepted.
